phase: discovery-nominated exploratory block probe on reused internal assessment images
design: 152 frozen metadata-only anchors, n5/9/13/17,m2/m5, exact fixed core and shared entrant reservoir; only frozen disjoint block pairs imply turnover m
classification: Within if complete class-count vectors of both exchanged blocks match under method labels, between otherwise; any unknown entrant excluded for that method and retained as unknown status. Same exact endpoints are reused across methods; no refusion for comparison.
primary: Per fixed n,m, compare conditional BEV mean/max and top3D mean/max, plus pairscale distances; no new pass threshold or single quality-geometry score
common_support: For each metric, require both within/between finite observations for both methods on the SAME anchor; average pairs within arm/anchor, anchors within true image, images within building, buildings equally. Separate all-observed common-anchor eligibility for mismatch/incomplete risks.
failure: Keep every attempted endpoint pair. Unknown, incomplete, different count, ambiguous etc never distance zero. Exclusive status-based different_count plus raw same_count failure, missing geometry and both_complete failure separately.
denominator: Publish frozen anchor count, attempted pair count, known-pair support and per-method/arm status per anchor; shared raw endpoints do not guarantee every method has both arms.
pure_class: Report only as separate sensitivity; primary uses complete vectors so mixed-composition libraries are not falsely called pure-class replacements.
ranking_limit: Do not rank from separate class-specific ABC curves. Same-library contrast is conditional on this selected reservoir and n,m; class-capacity and category-count differences remain relevant and disclosed.
uncertainty: Independent statistics worker checks original requests and endpoint distances then building bootstrap; small building counts and internal exploratory status retained. No adjustment of labels after these outcomes.
